posts.author: Mrketa91
posts.body:
Hello all,
Purpose
: I want to create a cutscene, where people are talking inside of a vehicle that is moving. So i need a parallax of a road in the countryside and one on a rocky road for example, in this way i can put it as background, creating the moving effect while the map is automatically scrolling.
More information:
For RPGMAKER MV, the Parallax should move vertically, so of course top and bottom should be the same to create continuity illusion. If someone has a folder or pictures of parallax appreciated,
I was wondering also if anybody is aware of free websites where i can get these kind of materials. I find it so hard to locate these kind of free resources online.
*Hope i follow all the rules! I am new here, thanks in advance to all!

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Mave you thought about just mapping one? That one you can have something that basically aligns with the environments that you already have!
For example:
I quickly made this with the default tiles (you should of course use the tiles you usually use for outdoor stuff):
While mapping I already paid attention that top and bottom line up, but you can use a trick to ensure that it really is vertically seamless:
My MV is German, but for you it would be the option "shift".
Here I used 10 in Y and this is my result:
As you can see, my testmap already was seamless, but by shifting, the seam moves from the rim to the middle of your map and you have an easier time fixing it.
Here is the result btw:
As said, this is a quick example to show that it works, I would make a map that is a lot longer so it is less repetetive, you can either take a mapshot tool or make screenshots and stitch them together or whatever to get the parallax you need
